svg.text: Normal HR75 fast LA AV-plane residual review

Only normal-hr75 is evaluated here. Candidate traces require source surface, MVF, blood-volume PV phase, hidden-volume cleanliness, and blood v-loop area >= 40 for visual triage; prime readbacks are ignored.
Candidate count: 2; fastest loop report rows: 181. This artifact is a visual research shortcut, not broad-envelope acceptance.
